extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text for Arabic OCR and document parsing.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Paired samples were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting the HTML to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website (https://www.hindawi.org/).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Converting scraped HTML content from the Hindawi website into PDFs and extracting Markdown text representations paired with book page images.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Input images of size 896 × 672 pixels are progressively downsampled via the vision encoder to 224 × 168, 112 × 84, 56 × 42, and 28 × 21, yielding 588 tokens.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Promotes the digitization of underrepresented languages such as Arabic, and provides resources to advance Arabic OCR and NLP research.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: May not generalize well to non-book domains (scientific, religious, historical documents) or multilingual/mixed-script content. Does not handle documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts (dense tables, charts, or images) effectively without additional preprocessing or adaptation.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Fine-tuning and evaluating vision transformer models for Arabic OCR and structured Markdown extraction from Arabic book pages.
